title: Decoherence is loss of recoverable coherence, not a collapse postulate

statements.text: Environmental coupling lowers the accessible phase coherence of a subsystem, $dR_{\mathrm{phase}}/dt < 0$, while global unitary evolution stays lawful. This is bookkeeping of recoverability, not a new collapse postulate.

sources.quote: This is not a new collapse postulate. It is a recoverability bookkeeping statement expressing how accessible coherence diminishes under environmental coupling while global unitary evolution remains lawful.
